time.desc: The social platform involved permanently banned accounts that pretended to be related to the parties involved and posted false information.
The accuser involved issued a self-defense statement in an attempt to respond to the controversy over his dissertation and evidence collection, which aroused further attention.
A third party related to the incident filed a civil lawsuit against the university involved on reputation and other issues.
Another university (Institution B) officially revoked Person B’s doctoral admission qualification and removed him from the list of proposed doctoral students.

After a statement appeared on the Internet that "a certain university has canceled the admission qualifications of the party accused of the incident", the school publicly clarified that it had not admitted or accepted the relevant admission matters.
Blogger exposed the accuser's falsification of test transcripts and academic integrity issues in past award-winning papers
After losing the first instance, Character B was accused of continuing to incite online violence and threatening and harassing the judge presiding over the case.
Multiple versions of judgment documents were found to contain suspected deleted fragments in online dissemination, triggering intense doubts about the authenticity of the documents.
Platform posts allege that there are organized accounts that continue to clear ground for the accuser and discredit the accused, implying manipulation of public opinion.
Mainstream media published comments criticizing the universities involved for using excuses to wait for superiors and refusing to promptly correct and punish them.
A blogger's article supporting the accuser was blocked and removed from the platform a few hours after it was published. The blogger said he was besieged by organized reports.
The civil dispute case involved was confirmed by the court to have entered the second instance procedure and the case filing and acceptance was completed.

It was revealed that Organization K hid the disciplinary documents against Person A on the school network and was only accessible through the school IP. This was interpreted by the outside world as a wait-and-see strategy waiting for the final judicial review.
Several high school classmates and alumni of the accused party provided real-name materials to reporters to prove their history of misconduct in high school.
Media reported that a large number of brotherly aid accounts have emerged on social platforms to teach men strategies for dealing with sexual harassment accusations and even violent confrontations.

The thesis involved was removed from the public literature platform. The platform’s customer service explained that the removal must be triggered by the author and the school. The school said it was verifying it.
In addition to Character B’s dissertation being removed from the shelves, his mentor’s related articles have also been withdrawn.
The court of second instance made the final ruling and upheld the original judgment, rejecting all appeals from the accuser, and the civil dispute entered judicial finality.
The main person in charge of the party committee of the university involved was replaced. The arrival of the new person in charge was closely connected with the subsequent error correction report.

The university involved issued a review notice: it revoked the disciplinary sanctions against the accused party, determined that the accuser's paper contained a large number of irregularities but did not constitute academic misconduct, and maintained the degree, while holding relevant personnel accountable.

Organization K announced the accountability of relevant responsible persons in the notification, including suspending the enrollment qualifications of the tutors involved for two years and giving relevant managers intra-party warnings or admonishments.

The announcements from the universities involved showed that each of them had fifty major objections, triggering further public doubts about the zero cost of false accusations and the attribution of responsibility.
In the review report, the university involved responded to multiple online rumors and refuted them one by one, triggering a new round of controversy over the credibility of the report.
Organization K clarified in the report that the rumor that "Character B's uncle holds the title A in the school" is not true

The university involved once again released a more detailed review description, disclosed the scale of expert team and material verification, and reiterated the conclusion of the cancellation of sanctions and degree maintenance.
The accusers involved in the incident spoke out intensively on social platforms to confront netizens and defend themselves, bringing about a new round of fluctuations in public opinion.

The accuser involved claimed to have passed a certain type of recruitment examination on a social platform and then quickly changed his story and admitted that it was false, triggering intensive discussions about his continued hype and qualification review.
